literal: Do not think of things that diminish the spirit; do not take, in sorrow, the friendship of those who cut off support.
translation: Do not harbor thoughts that diminish your spirit; do not accept the friendship of those who abandon you in times of sorrow.
modern: மன ஊக்கத்தைக் குறைக்கும் செயல்களை எண்ணாதிருக்க வேண்டும்; துன்பம் வந்த காலத்தில் துணையை விட்டு விலகுபவரின் நட்பைக் கொள்ளாதிருக்க வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet advises against two harmful things: discouraging thoughts and unreliable friends. First, one should not entertain thoughts that shrink the mind or diminish one's spirit. Second, one should never accept the friendship of those who sever their support when sorrow or trouble strikes. The word 'ஆற்று' (the oblique form of 'ஆறு', meaning way or support) combined with 'அறுப்பார்' vividly describes fair-weather friends who cut off their ties and leave one stranded in difficult times.
